preconditions.description: The number of elements in the linked list is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K_i <= 10^5 for K_i in K)
preconditions.description: Each element in the linked list is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output is a string representation of the level order traversal of the constructed binary tree
postconditions.description: The output must be a string where each number is separated by a space, representing the level order traversal of the binary tree constructed from the linked list.

invariants.expression: The binary tree is constructed correctly according to the given linked list representation.
invariants.description: The binary tree is constructed by linking nodes according to the positions specified by the linked list, ensuring that the left and right children of a node at position i are at positions 2*i+1 and 2*i+2 respectively.
